jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. Critical: the effect itself must contain no cyan, aqua, turquoise or pale sky-blue anywhere, so it stays clearly separable from the cyan background when the background is keyed out. This is a hero's own skill, willed and composed — it should read as resolve, not as a threat. Even the final dissipation frame must still show a clearly visible shape, never fade to nothing. The effect is a heart of gathered light that opens outward, flies, and blooms. Frame 1 a small warm point folds in on itself. Frames 2-4 it opens into a heart-shaped bloom of light and travels right, trailing soft petals of glow. Frame 6 it opens fully into a broad radiant ring with a heart at its core. Frames 7-8 the ring softens and a few warm motes settle downward like a kindness returning. Palette: warm gold and honey, rose-cream, white-hot core, no blue of any kind.
